name: School
layout: Contemporary middle-school campus used as a multi-zone location: exterior gate/fence, hallway, and classroom interior. Story treats these as connected wings of one school rather than separate campuses.
key_landmarks: Fence line (crisis action zone near after-hours)
Classroom with rows of desks and a board
Hallway with shoe lockers or classroom doors
Festival display board / art wall (late chapters)
furniture_objects: Festival art display stands or wall clips
visual_identifiers: Clean institutional architecture with simple vertical window grids
Readable peer silhouettes in backgrounds without crowding
School clocks, chalk dust, and notice papers as texture
Daytime default; after-hours fence scene uses emptier grounds
camera_possibilities: Gate establishing two-shot for Ren/Kaito arrivals
Fence-line action wide for Unfinished crisis
Festival wall medium shots for praise beat
continuity_constraints: Keep uniform architecture language across classroom/hallway/gate
Ren and Kaito seating relationship can stay consistent if shown repeatedly
Festival board appears only after it is introduced in story timing
After-hours fence scene should feel like the same school exterior family
Avoid turning school into fantasy architecture except when Echo effects intrude
